jobs.label: Metal Gear Solid Mobile — garde olive, variante N-Gage
jobs.prompt: Create exactly one full-body isolated game sprite of the guard on the LEFT in the attached native Metal Gear Solid Mobile N-Gage screenshot. Reconstruct that one particular original 2008 mobile game character as faithfully as possible: short brown hair, simple light-skinned angular low-polygon face, olive mustard long-sleeve fatigues and matching loose trousers, dark blue-gray protective vest and shoulder harness, dark gloves, black calf-height boots with flat angular soles, compact dark rifle held diagonally across the front in exactly the same calm standing-ready pose facing slightly right. Use only the LEFT guard as the subject; the back-facing guard at right is a secondary view of the outfit, never a second figure in the output. Preserve the low-polygon geometric silhouette, plain flat game textures, few folds, original proportions and subdued palette. Do not upgrade into a realistic modern tactical soldier: no new pouches, radio, helmet, knee pads, facial hair or detailed firearm modifications. Keep the complete head, hands, rifle and both boots visible with generous transparent margins. Pure transparent RGBA, no cafeteria, walls, other figures, text, HUD, checkerboard, floor or shadow. One original-game-styled guard only.

jobs.label: MGO1 — Rowdy Reiko, tenue et pose de Subsistence
jobs.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body character sprite of the adult female character Rowdy Reiko as she actually appears in the attached native PS2 Metal Gear Online 1 / MGS3 Subsistence gameplay storyboard sheets. Use the clearly visible upright neutral idle stance in the TOP MIDDLE panel of the first sheet and the front/three-quarter views across the second sheet. Preserve this specific game incarnation and its original textured PS2 model proportions: short swept-back pale blonde hair, dark narrow sunglasses, black long-sleeved fitted jacket, the same light narrow front trim/tie visible in the game, black short lower garment, uncovered thighs, matching tall black knee-high boots, and the visible leg markings only as supported by the reference. Arms resting at the sides in the neutral game idle stance; full-body frontal three-quarter view angled slightly to the right. This is a neutral costume reference sprite of an adult videogame character, not a posed glamour image. Keep the same coverage of clothing and the same silhouette as the gameplay reference; do not substitute Rumble Roses alternate wrestling costumes or camouflage trousers from normal Reiko. Preserve simple PS2-era texture and shading, do not turn into anime, photography or redesign. Exactly ONE figure, no sheet or duplicates. Entire head, both hands and both boots inside the frame with generous clear margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no environment, text, UI, logos, floor or cast shadow.

jobs.label: TPP — Dr Evangelos Constantinou, tenue de l’hôpital
jobs.prompt: Create exactly one neutral full-body isolated character source sprite of the older male doctor Evangelos Constantinou from the retail game Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain hospital prologue, accurately grounded in the attached native cutscene storyboard sheets. The doctor is the bald older man in the white coat, NOT the bearded patient or the blonde/black-haired women. Use his clear upper-body views from row 3 of the FIRST sheet and the first two rows of the SECOND sheet; his dark trouser cuffs and dark shoes are visible next to the bed in row 3 of the second sheet. Preserve his balding head with gray side hair, close gray facial hair, round thin metal-rimmed glasses, middle-aged/older lined narrow face, light turquoise green collared shirt open at the neck, white long-sleeved physician's coat with lapels and the small actual chest badge/pocket details, straight dark gray trousers, plain dark low leather shoes. No necktie, gloves, surgical mask, weapon, tactical equipment or invented insignia. Show him standing naturally, calm and attentive, hands relaxed, facing three-quarter right. Preserve his lean adult proportions and restrained Fox Engine game rendering with the observed clothing construction and colors. This is his hospital narrative appearance, no combat pose, no injury. Entire head, hands and both shoes visible with transparent margin all round. One character only on true transparent RGBA, no bed, patient, other people, hospital, medical props, lettering, ground or shadows. Never reproduce the storyboard layout or interface.
